categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: modified plastics, petrochemical materials, and fine chemicals. The modified plastics segment includes plastic particles and products used in holiday lighting, automotive, new energy batteries, home appliances, optical displays, cables, and medical hygiene. The petrochemical materials segment focuses on liquefied petroleum gas products and polystyrene. The fine chemicals segment produces halogen-free flame retardants, phosphorus chemicals, and raw materials for daily chemicals, serving coatings, modified plastics, electrolytes, pigments, and cosmetics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core proprietary technologies including halogen-free flame retardant chemical synthesis and compounding, flame retardant modified plastics preparation, functional polymer materials, and liquefied petroleum gas processing. It employs advanced manufacturing processes such as solid-phase reaction control, one-step synthesis methods, automated PLC production systems, and specialized equipment like double-screw extruders and reaction vessels with heat control. The company also invests in R&D for new materials like LCD photoresists, polyimide monomers, organic photovoltaic materials, anion exchange membranes, graphene conductive applications, and biodegradable bio-based materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span multiple industries including holiday lighting manufacturers (e.g., Lisheng Group, Zhongyu Electric), automotive OEMs (e.g., GAC Toyota, BYD, XPeng, Dongfeng Nissan), new energy battery producers (e.g., CATL), home appliance brands (e.g., Midea, Gree, Whirlpool), optical display companies (e.g., LG Electronics, Samsung, Hisense), cable manufacturers, and medical hygiene markets in Africa. The petrochemical segment serves major oil companies like Sinopec and CNOOC. Fine chemical products are supplied to global coating companies (e.g., Akzo Nobel, PPG) and chemical pigment manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong, Anhui, Hunan, and Jiangsu provinces. It has overseas subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Vietnam, Nigeria, Cambodia, and Angola, focusing on sales and production of modified plastics and hygiene products. The company actively expands its overseas market presence, especially in Africa and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical materials supply chain. It produces petrochemical raw materials (upstream), manufactures modified plastics and fine chemicals (midstream), and supplies application-specific products to end customers in automotive, electronics, consumer goods, and industrial sectors (downstream). It also extends into product application development and customized solutions, integrating vertically along the chemical new materials industry chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on platform-based tree management, amoeba fission operations, disruptive product innovation, and industry chain integration. It prioritizes R&D investment in high-performance, multifunctional, and green new materials, including flame retardants, photovoltaic materials, ion exchange membranes, graphene applications, and biodegradable polymers. The company collaborates with top universities and research institutes to maintain technological leadership and expand its patent portfolio. It aims to enhance product quality, broaden application fields, and accelerate commercialization of frontier materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of modified plastics, petrochemical products, and fine chemicals. The company employs a direct sales model complemented by distributors, serving both domestic and international customers. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing but focuses on manufacturing and trading of chemical materials and products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic high-performance plastics and resin manufacturer with differentiated competitive advantages in China. It competes with international giants like BASF, SABIC, Bayer, DuPont, and Dow in high-end modified plastics. The company has established strategic partnerships with major customers and maintains a strong brand reputation. It is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' and a manufacturing single champion in flame retardant polypropylene.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.08 billion, a 10.72% increase year-over-year. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined sharply to a loss of RMB 236 million due to goodwill impairment and increased expenses from new business development. Total assets reached RMB 5.11 billion with a net asset value of RMB 1.3 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, with a stable growth trajectory in revenue but facing profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core proprietary technologies, high-quality product standards, and customized solutions tailored to strategic customers. It offers environmentally friendly, halogen-free flame retardants and advanced modified plastics that meet international standards such as RoHS and REACH. Its products provide enhanced flame retardancy, mechanical strength, and multifunctionality, supporting applications in automotive lightweighting, new energy batteries, and optical displays. The company’s integrated industry chain and strong R&D capabilities enable it to deliver innovative, sustainable, and high-performance chemical materials.
